resume: Length of the leave, notice periods for your employer, daily allowances paid by the CGSS de La Réunion and documents to send, plus the additional birth leave.
aQuoiCaSert: Paternity and childcare leave (congé de paternité et d'accueil de l'enfant) allows the father, or the mother's spouse, PACS partner (civil partnership) or cohabiting partner, to stop working after the birth to look after the child. During this leave, the employment contract is suspended and the Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance), run in Réunion by the CGSS (Caisse générale de sécurité sociale, the local social security fund), may pay daily allowances. An additional birth leave (congé supplémentaire de naissance) can then be added.
quiEstConcerne: The mother's spouse, PACS partner or cohabiting partner, if not the father.
This guide concerns private-sector employees: civil servants, self-employed people and other schemes have their own rules.
aSavoir: Separated parents: the child's father is entitled to the leave with no requirement of marriage, PACS or living with the mother.
Length: 25 calendar days for a birth (32 for multiple births), after the 3-working-day birth leave. A 4-day period is mandatory right after this birth leave.
The remaining days (21, or 28 for multiple births) are optional and are taken within 6 months of the birth.

Tell your employer at least 1 month before the expected date of delivery, then at least 1 month before the start of the leave, stating its length. Doing so in writing is advised. If these notice periods are respected, the employer cannot refuse.

Daily allowances: among other conditions, you must have had a social security number for at least 6 months and have worked 150 hours in the previous 3 months, or paid contributions on at least €12,058.20 of salary over 6 months. Amount: from €11.12 to €104.02 per day.
Additional birth leave: it can be taken after paternity leave. Its conditions and pay are detailed on the Code du travail numérique (the official labor law website).
